ICS 13.220.10CED 22Reaffirmed 20181. SCOPEThis standard recommends procedures to be used in the transfer of Halon 1211 and HaIon 1301 from one container to another to reduce unnecessary emission of these halons to the atmosphere. It also provides recommendations and information relevant to the health and safety of persons engaged in such procedures.2. REFERENCESThe standard listed below contains provisions which through reference in this text, constitutes provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated was valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standard indicated below:15220: 2002 Specification for halogenated hydrocarbons - Halon 1211 and halon 1301 - Fire extinguishing media
